other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Generic description of cell (grid) manufacturing lists continuous casting and rolling as a production option for the lead alloy, though the studied factory is a discrete/batch battery plant
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
The cells are manufactured by means 
of casting in book molds, or through continuous 
processes such as stamping, extrusion or continuous 
casting with subsequent rolling.
other_continuous_flow_signals.sector: continuous casting / rolling (lead alloy) — generic process mention

one_line: The paper applies ISO 50001 energy planning/management to a Colombian lead-acid battery factory (discrete/batch manufacturing), reducing electricity use via fixes to battery formation, compressed air, and electric motors.
